provenance.source: Original pinned EXE stopped at its real entry under WineDbg; repeated at 0x907bf3 with the same control/status fields. Wine 11 on macOS ARM64, not native x86 hardware.

umbra.status: Explicit isolated DLL-attach input chosen to match the measured main-entry FP state; original DLL_PROCESS_ATTACH FP input has not been captured. This is not initialized-game evidence.

image_tls.provenance: Parsed at runtime from hash-verified mapped PE32 headers and template data; callbacks must be empty. Main PE TLS directory RVA 0x75a148 and index address 0xc3eed4. Native synthetic DLL check covers nonzero template, zero-fill and thread isolation. New native thread transport is not implemented.

dll_attach_arguments.status: Chosen partial attach input. Original startup DLL_PROCESS_ATTACH register/FP/reserved context remains uncaptured; reserved-null is not a claim about the original static-import loader.

startup_composition.main_boundary: The intervening Windows loader context is uncaptured. Supply measured main FP controls/status and unknown incoming non-SP GPRs/flags; clear DF and mapped ESP are known. Reset stack contents to unknown, retaining only the declared return sentinel.
startup_composition.preserved: Guest module data, native allocation ownership, module/symbol registry, native TLS/FLS and partial thread state share one process. Attach must return nonzero with stdcall stack cleanup, clear DF and restored FS:[0].
startup_composition.status: Partial loader composition only; dependency attach order, image TLS and full TEB/PEB remain incomplete.

unimplemented: nonempty image TLS callback dispatch and native-to-guest new-thread TLS/context transport
full Windows dependency/loader initialization order beyond Umbra attach before EXE entry
native callback signatures other than main-thread FLS; threading contexts
